title: Good Habits Paragraph
titleMy: ကောင်းသော အလေ့အကျင့်များ စာပိုဒ်
description: A short essay about habits; the repetitions in the words mirror the repetitions in the message.

exercises.instruction: Read the sentence first, then type it in one smooth pass.
exercises.text: Good habits start with small steps. If you read a little every day, you will read many books in a year. If you practice typing daily, your speed and accuracy will grow quickly. Keep going and never give up.
